entries.title: Free release lint finds a new untranslated string
entries.root_cause: The free flavor adds the harbor_count string without a French translation, so it is absent from the lint baseline. Add the translation or explicitly resolve the new lint finding.

entries.title: Paid release lint finds a new untranslated string
entries.root_cause: The paid flavor adds the berth_status string without a French translation, producing a separate finding absent from its lint baseline. Add the paid flavor translation or explicitly resolve that finding.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same MissingTranslation lint check fails against another variant and a different string resource; fixing harbor_count does not fix berth_status.

entries.title: Paid release translation finding remains outside the baseline
entries.root_cause: The paid flavor adds the berth_status string without a French translation, producing a separate finding absent from its lint baseline. Add the paid flavor translation or explicitly resolve that finding.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later run has additional completed tasks and the resource moved to another line, but the paid variant still reports berth_status.

entries.title: Kotlin compilation cannot resolve a formatter
entries.root_cause: The Kotlin source refers to formatTideLabel, which is not defined or imported. Restore the formatter or correct the reference.
